sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Hare Krishna Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Amit Srivastava
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1.

Applicant-Mukesh Verma has approached this Court by way of filing present bail application seeking enlargement on bail in Case Crime No. 255 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 506, 326A, 120B IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Jagdishpura, District Agra.
2. This application is pending for about five years.
Sri Hare Krishna Tripathi, learned counsel for applicant is not present.

3. Sri D.P.S. Chauhan, learned AGA appearing for State, submits that applicant is husband, who caused grievous injuries to his wife by using acid, which is punishable with minimum sentence upto 10 years and extended upto life imprisonment.
He further submits that at this stage present status of trial is not on record.

Mukesh Verma vs State Of U.P. on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2564508/
1 4. In aforesaid circumstances and considering that applicant is in jail since 01.05.2019 and present status of trial is not on record, in the interest of justice, even in absence of counsel for applicant, this application is disposed of with liberty to applicant to approach afresh after a reasonable period.
